name: Camp LMNTREE
description_short: Full-summer day camp at The Elemen-Tree House in Franklin, MA, with weekly themes, field trips, group games, free swim with a certified lifeguard on duty, and arts and crafts. Weekly sessions from the last day of school; full and part time campers welcome. Summer hours 7:00 am to 6:00 pm.
swim_waterfront_notes: Free swim is offered. A certified lifeguard is on duty at all times.

sources.note: Contact and Tuition page: Summer Camp weekly tuition, one child, 4/5 days $349.00 ... 1 day $87.00
Camp Schedule page: SUMMER 2026 Schedule, weekly themes June 22 to Sept 4, closed June 29 to July 3; session price is the 4/5-day one-child weekly rate

warnings: The page doesn't give a season year, dates, prices, or ages. Check the Camp Schedule and Contact and Tuition pages for 2027 details.

This site belongs to a childcare center that also runs preschool and school-year programs. The summer camp is one of its programs. It is open 6:30 am - 6:00 pm during the school year and 7:00 am - 6:00 pm in summer.
